answer: Reef-Linked Kernel Witnesses.** Each agent identity must publish a kernel hash derived from a hardware-sealed key and a reef of cross-attested device fingerprints. A new identity whose witness graph overlaps an existing identity's closed neighborhood is flagged automatically, since honest agents maintain disjoint attestation sets. Enrolling a duplicate requires acquiring fresh hardware and a distinct walnut-tier witness set, raising marginal cost per sybil above the reward any single identity can extract. Collusion is detectable as anomalous witness-graph density.
